raw_text_content: Pink Pony Pub & Club | Gulf Shores Restaurant & Bar in AL. Pink Pony Pub has been a beachfront staple of Gulf Shores for 50+ years. Located directly on Gulf Shores beach. Open everyday 10:30am to 10pm. Children welcome until 9pm. The sun rises in the Gulf. Feeling hungry? Menu. We've been surviving hurricanes since 1956. Featured Drinks: Bob Marley - Strawberry, Pina Colada, banana, melon, orange, coconut rum & dark rum. Served in a Pink Pony Pub souvenir glass. Malibu Bushwhacker - Malibu Rum, Dark Creme de Cocoa, Irish Creme & Vanilla Creme. Pina Colada - A Pink Pony signature frozen drink that includes premium rum, coconut cream & fresh pineapple juice. Location: 137 E Gulf Pl, Gulf Shores, AL. Phone: (251) 948-6371. Open everyday 11am - 10pm. Children welcome until 9pm. Follow us on Facebook, Twitter, Instagram. View the Beach Cam.
